run_biencoder_training: run the biencoder ranker training loop with adversarial training and FAISS index search
evaluate_biencoder_model: evaluate the biencoder ranker model on a validation dataloader and compute precision recall and F1
get_optimizer_for_model: get a BERT optimizer for the biencoder model with configurable learning rate and FP16 support
get_scheduler_for_training: get a warmup linear scheduler for the training optimizer based on batch size and epochs
process_mention_data: process mention data samples into tensor datasets using the BERT tokenizer for training or evaluation
